text:
A polar bear walks down the main street.
A pregnant woman packs her bags and boards a plane, because no baby is born in this town.
And on the hill above the houses, there's a cemetery that stopped taking the dead seventy-five years ago.
This is Longyearbyen. The northernmost town on Earth.
You can't be born here. You can't be buried here.
For four months a year, the sun doesn't rise at all.
And past the last house, nobody walks without a rifle.
And yet, more than two thousand people refuse to leave.
By the end of this video, you'll understand why.
